T: Three tasks. One ball. Plenty of food.
D: Harry is entered into a dangerous tournament between three schools of magic.
P: Serve the feast at the Yule Ball.
S: the camp outside the Quidditch World Cup
Pork sausages fried slowly in a heavy pan until sticky, in soft rolls with fried onions and brown sauce.
the Yule Ball in the Great Hall
Smoked salmon blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and mini Yorkshire puddings with rare beef and horseradish cream, on silver trays.
the first task with the dragons
Chorizo cooked in a hot pan with honey and chilli flakes until sticky, on toothpicks with cubes of sharp cheddar.
M: the Christmas feast before the dancing
Beef rib roast roasted at 220C then 160C to 52C, rested, with roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings, honey carrots and red wine gravy.
Onion, fennel and garlic softened in olive oil with saffron and orange peel, tomato and fish stock simmered 20 minutes, white fish, mussels and prawns added. Garlic toast and aioli.
W: the frozen Great Hall decorated for the ball
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, white chocolate shavings and berries dusted with icing sugar like frost.
K: a cold winter night at the castle
Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise for 15 minutes, served warm.

s.note: the camp outside the Quidditch World Cup
s.how: Fry 8 pork sausages slowly in a heavy pan until sticky. Fry 2 sliced onions in butter until golden. Put in 8 soft rolls with the onions and a good squirt of brown sauce.

s.note: the first task with the dragons
s.how: Slice 300g chorizo and fry in a hot pan until crisp. Add 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of chilli flakes and cook until sticky. Spear on toothpicks with cubes of 150g sharp cheddar.

m.note: the Christmas feast before the dancing
m.how: Roast a 2kg beef rib roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Bake Yorkshires from 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk at 220C. Glaze 4 carrots with honey. Make gravy with 200ml red wine.

w.note: the frozen Great Hall decorated for the ball
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 50g white chocolate shavings and 250g berries dusted with icing sugar.

d.note: a cold winter night at the castle
d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, orange peel and 2 star anise for 15 minutes. Strain and serve warm in mugs.
